quests.title: Market Economist Challenge
quests.description: Analyze market structures and make economic decisions like a professional economist!

story.introduction: The Economic Research Institute needs your expertise to analyze different market scenarios and predict economic outcomes!

steps.title: Demand and Supply Analysis
steps.narrative: Professor Economy presents you with market data. Analyze the demand and supply patterns!

problem.question: If the price of tea increases, what will happen to the demand for coffee (assuming they are substitute goods)?
options: Demand for coffee will remain same
problem.explanation: When the price of a substitute good (tea) increases, demand for the alternative (coffee) increases as consumers switch to the relatively cheaper option.
